annotations.title: Check a long run's records signed by someone other than the agent, with a heartbeat on a clock. Agent transcripts and telemetry are not evidence

description: Check a long run's records signed by a key the records say is not the agent's (a host, runner or supervisor: the recorder), with a heartbeat on a clock. Send the records in order: each {v 1, type run-record, run_id, seq, kind start|heartbeat|event|end, at, prev, recorder_id, recorder_key, sig} chained by SHA-256; the start record names agent_id and heartbeat_s. Get back valid or invalid (signatures, chain, order), every check, heartbeat_kept, the run state (ended, running or silent), missed beats, and a summary signed by LLPRO with the time we saw it, checkable offline. Agent transcripts and telemetry are untrusted: carry only their SHA-256 as telemetry_hash. Pin expected_agent, expected_recorder and expected_head for the strongest result. We do not keep the records. It does not show who the recorder is or that the records are complete. Not an audit opinion, not a certification, not a qualified timestamp, not evidence of compliance. Free. Feeds the standards and regulatory road: run logs signed by someone other than the agent.

expected_agent.description: the agent public key you expect; if it differs (or the start record names none) the result is invalid

expected_head.description: the recorder's latest chain head you know of; if the last record sent is not it, the result is invalid (catches dropped newest records)

expected_recorder.description: the recorder public key you trust; if it differs the result is invalid

expected_records.description: the number of records you know exist; if a different number is sent the result is invalid

heartbeat_s.description: start record only: the promised beat in seconds

prev.description: 64 zeros for seq 0, else SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON of the previous record (with its sig)

recorder_key.description: the recorder's Ed25519 public key, canonical base64 (not the agent's key)

sig.description: recorder signature over the canonical JSON of the record without sig

telemetry_hash.description: optional: SHA-256 of what the agent reported (untrusted, carried only)
